## Fixes
- **CPU/RAM graphs in Docker rows line up again.** The action-button column had an automatic width, so every row sized its columns differently and the graphs started at a different place in each row. The column is fixed again (wide enough for all buttons), so the graphs sit in one straight column, with more space between them and the buttons.
- **The ▾ address menu is no longer hidden behind the side menu.** It used to open inside the row and could slide under the ArrHub menu on narrower windows. It now opens on top of everything, starts at the 🌐 button, stays inside the window (opens upwards near the bottom) and closes on a click elsewhere, scroll or Esc.
